name: aura-ems
description: AURA EMS - Enterprise Multi-Tenant Education Management System

scripts.build: cd backend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.render:build: npm run build && cd backend && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss --force-reset && npm run prisma:seed
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss
